description: netCI routes a run to a live Jenkins controller, the build executes on a throwaway agent pod, and the artifact plus its evidence come back through the API.

assertions.assertion: netCI is configured to drive Jenkins, not to wait for a hand-written callback
jenkins-a is reachable
jenkins-b is reachable
jenkins-a has no executors of its own
jenkins-a can provision the ephemeral agent label from a cloud
jenkins-b has no executors of its own
jenkins-b can provision the ephemeral agent label from a cloud
no build pods are lingering before the run
netCI recorded a controller-qualified external run id
the chosen controller is one of the registered controllers
the queue item resolved to a real build number
netCI provisioned a pipeline job, not a freestyle project
an ephemeral agent pod was created for the build
the agent pod does not auto-mount a Kubernetes API token
the agent pod mounts no host path and no container socket
the agent pod runs as a non-root user
the workspace is an emptyDir that dies with the pod
netCI recorded that it dispatched the build to a controller

assertions.assertion: the build called back to move the run out of queued

assertions.assertion: the build published an immutable digest through the callback
the evidence the build published describes the digest it reported
Syft generated the SBOM
Trivy produced the scan
Cosign signed the artifact
netCI allowed the artifact
the run moved past CI rather than staying queued
starting the run recorded the commit event DORA is measured from
the ephemeral agent pod was deleted once the build finished
